Parametric CAD Bench v3: agent runs
	

The scored trials behind the 13 systems on the Parametric CAD Bench v3
leaderboard: one final trial per system and task, 1,300 in total. The tasks
are published as runnable Harbor tasks at
gnucleus-ai/cad-bench@sha256:8a786725d3648a76282fc5868df06da3d5e00d603f283573a53430803465d78a.

	
		
	
	
		Layout
	


data/cad-bench-v3-runs.parquet: one row per trial.

runs/<agent>/<model>/<task_id>/: the trial's files.
result.json, config.json, trial.log… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/gnucleus-ai/cad-gen-freecad-bench-v3.
